Once upon a time: there was a bear who had a very strong arm. One day he decided to take a walk in the forest. As he stepped out of the trees, he noticed a little squirrel. She was very scared and ran away. The bear wanted to find her but he was so scared he stepped back in surprise. He didn't know how to walk or he hadn't seen any animals. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise. He looked up and saw a big bear with bright yellow hair and a funny looking man. The bear was standing right in the middle of the forest. The man was looking at him in a mirror and the bear smiled. The bear was so happy to see that he began to laugh. He put the man on his arm and they went on many more adventures. The bear never forgot his adventure and the angry bear kept smiling.
